<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of "size" bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of "size" bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 2*size bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="mul_a_ext" width_description="[7:0]">Extended multiplicand register.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_b_ext" width_description="[7:0]">Extended multiplier register.</reg>
        <reg id="partial_product[0]" width_description="[7:0]">Partial product register for bit 0.</reg>
        <reg id="partial_product[1]" width_description="[7:0]">Partial product register for bit 1.</reg>
        <reg id="partial_product[2]" width_description="[7:0]">Partial product register for bit 2.</reg>
        <reg id="partial_product[3]" width_description="[7:0]">Partial product register for bit 3.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg[0]" width_description="[7:0]">Register for storing the first stage of sums.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg[1]" width_description="[7:0]">Register for storing the second stage of sums.</reg>
        <reg id="product" width_description="[7:0]">Register for storing the final product.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Extend inputs by adding 'size' number of zeros at the MSB positions
        assign mul_a_ext = {4'd0, mul_a};
        assign mul_b_ext = {4'd0, mul_b};
        
        genvar i;
        generate
            for(i = 0; i < size; i=i+1) begin : gen_partial_products
                always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
                    if(!rst_n) begin
                        partial_product[i] <= 'd0;
                    end else begin
                        if(mul_b_ext[i]) begin
                            partial_product[i] <= mul_a_ext << i;
                        end else begin
                            partial_product[i] <= 'd0;
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Add of partial products
        integer j;
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                for(j = 0; j < 2; j=j+1) begin
                    sum_reg[j] <= 'd0;
                end
            end else begin
                sum_reg[0] <= partial_product[0] + partial_product[1];
                sum_reg[1] <= partial_product[2] + partial_product[3];
            end
        end
        
        // Final product calculation
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                product <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                product <= sum_reg[0] + sum_reg[1];
            end
        end
        
        // Assign the final product to the output port
        assign mul_out = product;
    </implementation>
</module>
